content.short: Frigid.ai provides AI-driven analytics and portfolio management tools to empower traders and collectors on Cardano.
content.description: Frigid.ai is a comprehensive AI-driven analytics and portfolio management platform specifically designed for the Cardano blockchain. Part of the Iceberg Labs suite, the tool provides traders and collectors with data-driven insights, market trend analysis, and sophisticated tracking for their digital assets. In collaboration with the Snek project, Frigid.ai also offers 'Bot-as-a-Service' (BaaS), enabling other ecosystem projects to integrate powerful token tracking and community engagement bots. The platform is committed to providing the transparency and tools needed for financial freedom.
